patch.value: Install the published-CLI oracle from a committed lockfile in CI

CI installs the conformance oracle with npm install -g @unbrained/pm-cli@<pin> and npm exec --package=..., pinning only the top-level package. The CLI ships no shrinkwrap (unbraind/pm-cli#1417), so a partially propagated OpenTelemetry 2.12.0 release failed all six runners in run 37472610207 (pm-rust-otel). Commit tests/oracle/package.json + package-lock.json, install with npm ci --prefix tests/oracle on Linux/macOS/Windows, point PM_NODE_CLI and the merge-driver/health steps at that install, update tests/release_pipeline_contract.rs pins, and let Dependabot (npm, /tests/oracle) bump it. Raised by CodeRabbit on PR #60 (comment 4200300693, zizmor adhoc-packages).
Every CI job installs the oracle via npm ci from a committed lockfile; zizmor reports no adhoc-packages; release_pipeline_contract pins the lockfile path; all six checks green
